instruction.text: We can meet our needs and wants with the help of other people. Spell the word to find out how.

feedback.finish: An exchange is when one person gives something to another person for something else. Have you ever swapped a toy for another toy before?

instruction.text: Toby and Raghul both collect monster cards. Each of them has a card the other wants. Drag the cards to complete the exchange.

feedback.finish: If the boys trade their cards with one another, they will both have what they want. This is a fair exchange.

instruction.text: Brianna has a bag of peaches but no lunch. Hanbi’s dad packed her two sandwiches for lunch but forgot her fresh fruit. Select the images to hear a description and match them to the correct text.

feedback.finish: Exchanges are important because different people have different things they might need or want. By making fair exchanges we make sure everyone is taken care of.

b.sound: Hanbi trades both of her sandwiches for one of Brianna’s peaches. Now Hanbi has no lunch.
Hanbi trades one of her sandwiches for one of Brianna’s peaches. Now both girls have a good lunch.
